description: Your picks, replayed honestly. Picks with timestamps and sizes in; what they made, pick by pick and in sum, every pick counted, the dead ones included, filled at the PumpSwap pool as it stood after your latency (graduates only; bonding-curve picks, and picks outside the archive, are counted in skipped_not_covered until curve fills ship), with every fee, the fixed costs and the bankroll you set. The most recent eight weeks come back apart from the rest, once per rule to each payer. A run is a queued job: the result is {id, state: queued}; poll replay_result with the id. $2 a run, USDC on Solana over x402; a run that fails is rerun free on the same id.

bankroll_sol.description: SOL at risk at once; a pick with no room is skipped

exit.description: take (x the entry), trail (share off the high), hold_s (seconds); any combination

latency_s.description: seconds from the decision to the fill

payment.description: the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value for this exact call (USDC on Solana). Leave it out to get the offer: the price, the payee and the network come back as the error content and as _meta['payment-required'].

picks.description: up to 500 a run for now; split the rest into another run

name: replay
